source.text: יְהוָ֣ה מָלָךְ֮ גֵּא֪וּת לָ֫בֵ֥שׁ לָבֵ֣שׁ יְ֭הוָה עֹ֣ז הִתְאַזָּ֑ר אַף־תִּכּ֥וֹן תֵּ֝בֵ֗ל בַּל־תִּמּֽוֹט׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH reigns; [with] majesty he is clothed; clothed [is] YHWH, [with] strength he has girded himself; indeed, [the] world is established; not it will be shaken.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} reigns; [with] majesty {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is clothed; \q {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is clothed; [with] strength {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has girded {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}. \q Indeed, the world is established; it will not be shaken.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is King! He has put on majesty like a robe; \q {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has dressed {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} and tied on strength like a belt. \q The world stands firm; nothing can shake it.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} rules as King! He wears greatness like a royal robe. \q He wears strength like a belt, ready to act. \q The world stands firm, and nothing can move it.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} règne ; [de] majesté {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est vêtu ; \q {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vêtu ; [de] force {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est ceint. \q Oui, le monde est affermi ; il ne sera pas ébranlé.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est roi ! Il a revêtu la majesté comme un manteau ; \q {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} s’est habillé, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a noué la force comme une ceinture. \q Le monde tient ferme ; rien ne peut l’ébranler.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} règne comme roi ! Il porte la grandeur comme un manteau royal. \q Il porte la force comme une ceinture, prêt à agir. \q Le monde tient bon, et rien ne peut le faire bouger.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anatawala; amevikwa enzi; \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amevikwa; amejifunga nguvu. \q Naam, ulimwengu umethibitishwa; hautatikisika.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni Mfalme! Amevaa enzi kama joho; \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amejivika, akajifunga nguvu kama mshipi. \q Ulimwengu umesimama imara; hakuna kitakachoutikisa.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anatawala kama Mfalme! Anavaa ukuu kama joho la kifalme. \q Anavaa nguvu kama mshipi, yuko tayari kutenda. \q Ulimwengu umesimama imara, wala hakuna kitakachouondoa.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reina; [de] majestad está vestido; \q vestido está {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; [de] poder se ha ceñido. \q Ciertamente, el mundo está afirmado; no será sacudido.
es.B: ¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es Rey! Se ha puesto la majestad como un manto; \q {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se ha vestido y se ha ceñido de poder como con un cinturón. \q El mundo está firme; nada lo puede sacudir.
es.R: ¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} gobierna como Rey! Lleva su grandeza como un manto real. \q Lleva su poder como un cinturón, listo para actuar. \q El mundo está firme, y nada lo puede mover.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trị vì; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mặc lấy sự uy nghi; \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mặc lấy, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thắt lưng bằng sức mạnh. \q Thật vậy, thế gian được lập vững; nó sẽ không bị lay động.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Vua! Ngài khoác sự uy nghi như chiếc áo choàng; \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã mặc áo và thắt sức mạnh như dây lưng. \q Thế gian đứng vững; không gì lay chuyển được.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cai trị như một vị Vua! Ngài mặc sự vĩ đại như áo choàng của vua. \q Ngài thắt sức mạnh như dây lưng, sẵn sàng hành động. \q Thế giới đứng vững, và không gì có thể làm nó lay chuyển.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 다스리신다. 그분께서 위엄을 입으셨다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 입으셨다. 능력으로 띠를 띠셨다. \q 참으로 세상이 굳게 서서 흔들리지 않는다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 왕이시다! 그분께서 위엄을 옷처럼 입으셨다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 옷을 입으시고 능력을 허리띠처럼 매셨다. \q 세상이 굳게 서 있으니, 아무것도 그것을 흔들 수 없다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 왕으로 다스리신다! 그분께서 위대하심을 왕의 옷처럼 입으셨다. \q 일하실 준비를 하시고 힘을 허리띠처럼 매셨다. \q 세상이 든든히 서 있어서 아무것도 그것을 움직일 수 없다.

pt.L: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} reina; [de] majestade {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} está vestido; \q {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} está vestido; [de] força {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se cingiu. \q Sim, o mundo está firme; não será abalado.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} é Rei! Ele vestiu a majestade como um manto; \q {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} se vestiu e prendeu a força à cintura como um cinto. \q O mundo está firme; nada pode abalá-lo.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} governa como Rei! Ele usa a grandeza como um manto real. \q Ele usa a força como um cinto, pronto para agir. \q O mundo está firme, e nada pode tirá-lo do lugar.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነገሠ፤ ግርማን ለበሰ፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለበሰ፤ ኃይልን ታጠቀ። \q ዓለምም በእርግጥ ጸንታለች፤ አትናወጥም።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ንጉሥ ነው! ግርማን እንደ ልብስ ለብሷል፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ራሱን አልብሷል፤ ኃይልንም እንደ መታጠቂያ ታጥቋል። \q ዓለም ጸንታ ቆማለች፤ ምንም አያነቃንቃትም።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ንጉሥ ይገዛል! ታላቅነትን እንደ ንጉሣዊ ካባ ለብሷል። \q ለሥራ ተዘጋጅቶ ብርታትን እንደ ቀበቶ ታጥቋል። \q ዓለም ጸንታ ቆማለች፤ ምንም ሊያነቃንቃት አይችልም።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} राज्य करते हैं; वे प्रताप पहने हुए हैं; \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} वस्त्र पहने हुए हैं; उन्होंने सामर्थ्य से अपनी कमर कसी है। \q हाँ, जगत स्थिर है; वह टलेगा नहीं।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} राजा हैं! उन्होंने प्रताप को वस्त्र के समान पहन लिया है; \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने वस्त्र पहनकर सामर्थ्य को कमरबंद की तरह बाँध लिया है। \q जगत दृढ़ खड़ा है; कोई उसे डगमगा नहीं सकता।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} राजा हैं! वे महानता को राजसी वस्त्र की तरह पहने हुए हैं। \q वे सामर्थ्य को कमरबंद की तरह बाँधे हुए हैं, काम करने को तैयार। \q जगत दृढ़ खड़ा है, और कोई उसे हिला नहीं सकता।

ru.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} царствует; в величие {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} облечён; \q облечён {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, силой {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} препоясался. \q И вот, утверждена вселенная, не поколеблется.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} — Царь! Он облёкся в величие, как в одежду; \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} оделся и опоясался силой, как поясом. \q Мир стоит твёрдо; ничто не сдвинет его.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} — Царь! Он носит величие, как царскую одежду. \q Он опоясан силой, как поясом, и готов действовать. \q Мир стоит твёрдо, и ничто не может сдвинуть его.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は王として治められる。威光を身にまとわれる。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は[衣を]まとい、力を帯として締められる。 \q まことに、世界は堅く立てられ、揺るがされることはない。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}こそ王である！その方は威光を衣のようにまとわれる。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は身を装い、力を帯のように締められる。 \q 世界は堅く据えられ、揺るぐことはない。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は王として治めておられる！その方は、偉大さを王の衣のように身に着けておられる。 \q 力を帯のように締めて、いつでも働く用意をしておられる。 \q 世界は堅く据えられ、何ものもそれを動かすことはできない。

decisions.choice: reigns: is King, has taken his throne
decisions.reason: The verb (malak) can mean "is king" or "has become king". The same cry opens 96:10, 97:1 and 99:1; with Psalms 47 and 95-99 these psalms celebrate the LORD as King.
A king's robe shows his majesty; to gird oneself is to tie up the robe with a belt, ready to act (18:33; 65:7).

decisions.choice: a psalm for the sixth day
decisions.reason: Psalm 93 has no title in the Hebrew. The Mishnah (Tamid 7:4) lists it as the psalm sung in the temple on the sixth day of the week, and the ancient Greek translation gives it a title for the day before the Sabbath.
Balanced and Readable bring out the shout that the LORD is King (m1).

decisions.choice: Verse 1 speaks about the LORD in the plain written style with the honorific; verses 2-5 speak to him in 합쇼체
decisions.reason: The psalm proclaims the LORD's reign in the third person and then turns to address him ("your throne"), and Korean follows each part with the voice the style guide (section 7a) gives it.
The cry that opens Psalms 93, 96:10, 97:1 and 99:1 (m1) is "O SENHOR é Rei!" at Balanced, as in the Portuguese of 1 Chronicles 16:31, which Psalm 96:10 repeats; Literal keeps the verb, "reina".
The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the English setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; the Amharic text has no deity_pronoun spans.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነገሠ" (the LORD reigns) at Literal, the verb of Revelation 19:6 in the Amharic New Testament; Balanced "ንጉሥ ነው", Readable "እንደ ንጉሥ ይገዛል", as the English levels
decisions.reason: Revelation 19:6 echoes the cry of these royal psalms; Literal keeps its verb. The line on the world ("ዓለምም በእርግጥ ጸንታለች፤ አትናወጥም") is worded as in 1 Chronicles 16:30 and Psalm 96:10, where the Hebrew is the same.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} राज्य करते हैं" (L); "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} राजा हैं!" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The cry that the LORD reigns (meaning m1) opens this psalm and recurs in 96:10, 97:1 and 99:1. Hindi gives it one wording in all the kingship psalms (93, 95-99), the wording of 1 Chronicles 16:31 in this translation: Literal keeps the verb, "राज्य करते हैं"; Balanced and Readable say "राजा हैं!", the English Readable's "rules as King" included, so the shout reads the same each time. God takes the honorific plural.

The last line has the Hebrew of 1 Chronicles 16:30 (and Psalm 96:10), so Literal and Balanced keep that verse's Hindi ("हाँ, जगत स्थिर है; वह टलेगा नहीं"; "जगत दृढ़ खड़ा है; कोई उसे डगमगा नहीं सकता"). Readable follows its own English, "nothing can move it".

One wording per level for the royal cry through the kingship psalms (93, 95-99), as 1 Chronicles 16:31 has it in this translation: Literal "царствует", Balanced and Readable "— Царь!". Readable keeps it where the English Readable says "rules as King".

alternatives: Да, вселенная утверждена и не поколеблется
decisions.reason: The Hebrew line is the same as 1 Chronicles 16:30b and Psalm 96:10, so Literal and Balanced keep that wording; Readable follows its own English here.
Russian says "girded himself" with a reflexive verb, which takes no deity_pronoun span, where the English has one on "himself".

decisions.choice: YHWH malakh "DNは王として治められる" (L), "DNこそ王である！" (B), "DNは王として治めておられる！" (R), as 1CH 16:31 (L, B); the same in 96:10, 97:1, 99:1
decisions.reason: The cry that the LORD is King, has taken his throne (m1, uncertain), keeps the Japanese of 1 Chronicles 16:31 (= Psalm 96:10) so the kingship psalms read alike. 'af-tikkon tevel bal-timmot is word for word 1CH 16:30, whose Japanese is kept at L and B.

decisions.choice: ge'ut lavesh "威光を身にまとわれる" (L), "威光を衣のようにまとわれる" (B); 'oz hit'azzar "力を帯として締められる" (L), "力を帯のように締められる" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Clothed and girded is dressed for action (m2); R spells out the readiness as the English R.

records.literal_gloss: Established [is] your throne from then; from everlasting [are] you.

en.L: Established [is] {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} throne from of old; \q from everlasting [are] {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: Your throne has stood firm from ancient days; \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have always been.
en.R: Your throne has been secure since time began. \q You have always existed.

fr.L: Affermi [est] {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} trône depuis jadis ; \q depuis toujours [es-]{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}.
fr.B: Ton trône tient ferme depuis les temps anciens ; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as toujours existé.
fr.R: Ton trône est solide depuis le début des temps. \q Tu as toujours existé.

sw.L: Kiti {{deity_pronoun:chako|Chako}} cha enzi kimethibitishwa tangu zamani; \q tangu milele [ndiwe] {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}.
sw.B: Kiti {{deity_pronoun:chako|Chako}} cha enzi kimesimama imara tangu siku za kale; \q {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umekuwako siku zote.
sw.R: Kiti {{deity_pronoun:chako|Chako}} cha enzi kimekuwa imara tangu mwanzo wa nyakati. \q Wewe umekuwako siku zote.

es.L: Afirmado [está] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} trono desde entonces; \q desde la eternidad [eres] {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}.
es.B: Tu trono está firme desde tiempos antiguos; \q {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has existido siempre.
es.R: Tu trono ha estado seguro desde que comenzó el tiempo. \q Tú siempre has existido.

vi.L: Ngôi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được lập vững từ thuở xưa; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [có] từ trước vô cùng.
vi.B: Ngôi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đứng vững từ những ngày xa xưa; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hiện hữu từ muôn thuở.
vi.R: Ngôi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vững chắc từ khi thời gian bắt đầu. \q Ngài vẫn luôn hiện hữu.

ko.L: 주님의 왕좌는 예로부터 굳게 서 있고, \q 주님은 영원부터 [계십니다].
ko.B: 주님의 왕좌는 아득한 옛날부터 굳게 서 있었고, \q 주님은 영원부터 계셨습니다.
ko.R: 주님의 왕좌는 세상이 시작될 때부터 든든했습니다. \q 주님은 언제나 계셨습니다.

pt.L: Firme [está] o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} trono desde outrora; \q desde a eternidade [existes] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}.
pt.B: O {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} trono está firme desde os tempos antigos; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} sempre exististe.
pt.R: O {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} trono está seguro desde o começo do tempo. \q Tu sempre exististe.

am.L: ዙፋንህ ከጥንት ጀምሮ የጸና [ነው]፤ \q አንተ ከዘላለም [ነህ]።
am.B: ዙፋንህ ከጥንት ዘመን ጀምሮ ጸንቶ ቆሟል፤ \q አንተ ሁልጊዜ ነበርህ።
am.R: ዙፋንህ ከዘመናት መጀመሪያ ጀምሮ ጽኑ ነው። \q አንተ ሁልጊዜ ነበርህ።

hi.L: तेरा सिंहासन प्राचीनकाल से स्थिर [है]; \q अनादि काल से तू [है]।
hi.B: तेरा सिंहासन आदि से दृढ़ बना है; \q तू सदा से है।
hi.R: तेरा सिंहासन सृष्टि के आरंभ से सुरक्षित है। \q तू सदा से है।

ru.B: Твой престол стоит прочно с древних дней; \q {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} был всегда.
ru.R: Твой престол стоит надёжно с начала времён. \q Ты существовал всегда.

ja.L: あなたの王座は昔から堅く立てられ、 \q とこしえから、あなたは[おられる]。
ja.B: あなたの王座は、いにしえの日々から堅く立っている。 \q あなたは、とこしえからおられる方。
ja.R: あなたの王座は、初めからずっと揺るがない。 \q あなたは、いつもおられた。

decisions.choice: established: the same word as the world in verse 1
decisions.reason: The world is established (verse 1) because God's throne is established (kun in both). His rule is older than the world.

decisions.choice: from then, from everlasting: from the beginning, with no beginning
decisions.reason: "From then" (me'az) is from the earliest time; "from everlasting" ('olam) goes back beyond it (90:2).
The same verb makes the world and the throne firm (m1), so Literal and Balanced say "firme" in both verses, and the reader can see that the world stands because the throne does.

decisions.choice: "स्थिर" for both the world (verse 1) and the throne
decisions.reason: The same verb says that the world and God's throne are established (meaning m1); Literal uses "स्थिर" for both so the link can be seen. The psalm now speaks to God with "तू".

decisions.choice: nakhon "堅く立てられ" (L), "堅く立っている" (B), as tikkon in 93:1; me'az / me'olam "昔から" / "とこしえから" (L)
decisions.reason: Established is the same word as the world in 93:1 (m1), so L and B repeat 堅く; from then and from everlasting is from the beginning, with no beginning (m2).

source.text: נָשְׂא֤וּ נְהָר֨וֹת׀יְֽהוָ֗ה נָשְׂא֣וּ נְהָר֣וֹת קוֹלָ֑ם יִשְׂא֖וּ נְהָר֣וֹת דָּכְיָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: The rivers have lifted up, YHWH, the rivers have lifted up their voice; the rivers lift up their pounding.

en.L: [The] rivers have lifted up, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, \q [the] rivers have lifted up their voice; \q [the] rivers lift up their pounding.
en.B: The rivers have risen, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}; \q the rivers have raised their roar; \q the rivers lift high their crashing waves.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, the floods have risen. \q They roar loudly. \q Their waves crash and pound.

fr.L: [Les] fleuves ont élevé, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q [les] fleuves ont élevé leur voix ; \q [les] fleuves élèvent leur fracas.
fr.B: Les fleuves ont monté, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; \q les fleuves ont élevé leur grondement ; \q les fleuves soulèvent leurs vagues qui se brisent.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, les flots ont monté. \q Ils grondent très fort. \q Leurs vagues se brisent et cognent.

sw.L: Mito imeinua, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q mito imeinua sauti yake; \q mito inainua mshindo wake.
sw.B: Mito imefurika, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; \q mito imepaza ngurumo yake; \q mito inainua juu mawimbi yake yanayopiga.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mafuriko yamepanda. \q Yanavuma kwa sauti kuu. \q Mawimbi yake yanapiga na kugonga.

es.L: Alzaron [los] ríos, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q alzaron [los] ríos su voz; \q alzan [los] ríos su estruendo.
es.B: Los ríos han crecido, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; \q los ríos han levantado su rugido; \q los ríos alzan en alto sus olas que rompen.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, las aguas han crecido. \q Rugen con fuerza. \q Sus olas chocan y golpean.

vi.L: Các sông đã dâng lên, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q các sông đã cất tiếng mình lên; \q các sông dâng lên tiếng sóng gầm.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, các sông đã dâng cao; \q các sông đã cất tiếng gầm vang; \q các sông nâng cao những đợt sóng ầm ầm.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, nước lũ đã dâng lên. \q Nước gầm thét vang dội. \q Sóng vỗ ầm ầm.

ko.L: 강물들이 높였습니다, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, \q 강물들이 그 소리를 높였습니다. \q 강물들이 그 부서지는 물결을 높입니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 강물들이 솟아올랐습니다. \q 강물들이 소리를 높여 울부짖습니다. \q 강물들이 부서지는 물결을 높이 쳐올립니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 큰물이 불어났습니다. \q 큰물이 요란하게 울부짖습니다. \q 그 물결이 부딪치며 세차게 칩니다.

pt.L: Levantaram os rios, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, \q levantaram os rios a sua voz; \q levantam os rios o seu estrondo.
pt.B: Os rios subiram, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}; \q os rios ergueram o seu rugido; \q os rios levantam bem alto as suas ondas que se quebram.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, as águas subiram. \q Elas rugem com força. \q As suas ondas batem e se quebram.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ወንዞች ከፍ አደረጉ፤ \q ወንዞች ድምፃቸውን ከፍ አደረጉ፤ \q ወንዞች ሞገዳቸውን ከፍ ያደርጋሉ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ወንዞች ተነሥተዋል፤ \q ወንዞች ጩኸታቸውን አሰምተዋል፤ \q ወንዞች የሚጋጩ ማዕበሎቻቸውን ከፍ ያደርጋሉ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ጎርፎች ተነሥተዋል። \q በታላቅ ድምፅ ይጮኻሉ። \q ማዕበሎቻቸው ይጋጫሉ፤ ይመታሉም።

hi.L: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, नदियों ने उठाया है, \q नदियों ने अपना शब्द उठाया है; \q नदियाँ अपने थपेड़े उठाती हैं।
hi.B: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, नदियाँ उमड़ आई हैं; \q नदियों ने अपना गर्जन ऊँचा किया है; \q नदियाँ अपनी टकराती लहरें ऊँची उठाती हैं।
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, बाढ़ का पानी चढ़ आया है। \q वह ज़ोर से गरजता है। \q उसकी लहरें टकराती और थपेड़े मारती हैं।

ru.L: Подняли реки, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, \q подняли реки свой голос; \q поднимают реки свой грохот.
ru.B: Поднялись реки, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}; \q реки возвысили свой рёв; \q реки высоко вздымают свои грохочущие волны.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, поднялись потоки. \q Они громко ревут. \q Их волны с грохотом бьются.

ja.L: 川々は上げた、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、 \q 川々はその声を上げた。 \q 川々は、そのとどろきを上げる。
ja.B: 大河は高まった、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ。 \q 大河はとどろきを上げた。 \q 大河は、砕ける波を高く上げる。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、洪水が押し寄せてきた。 \q 洪水は大きな音をたててとどろく。 \q その波は激しく打ち寄せる。

decisions.choice: the rivers: the waters of chaos
decisions.reason: The rivers and the sea (verse 4) stand for the powers that rage against God's order, the waters he tamed at creation and at the Red Sea (74:13; 89:10-11; 46:3-4).
The word (dokhi) is found only here; from a verb meaning to crush, it is the pounding of breakers.
The line is said three times, each time growing (92:10), like waves rising.

decisions.choice: neharot "川々" (L), "大河" (B), "洪水" (R); dokhyam "そのとどろき" (L), "砕ける波" (B), "その波は激しく打ち寄せる" (R)
decisions.reason: The rivers are the waters of chaos (m1); dokhyam is the crash of waves (m2, uncertain). The three-fold line (m3) is kept at L and B.

source.text: מִקֹּל֨וֹת׀מַ֤יִם רַבִּ֗ים אַדִּירִ֣ים מִשְׁבְּרֵי־יָ֑ם אַדִּ֖יר בַּמָּר֣וֹם יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: More than [the] sounds of many waters, majestic [than] [the] breakers of [the] sea, majestic in the height [is] YHWH.

en.L: More than the sounds of many waters, \q more majestic than the breakers of the sea, \q majestic on high [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Above the roar of the great waters, \q above the crash of the ocean's breakers, \q {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is majestic on high.
en.R: The floods roar loudly, \q and the ocean's waves are strong, \q but {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in heaven is far greater.

fr.L: Plus que les voix des grandes eaux, \q plus majestueux que les brisants de la mer, \q majestueux dans les hauteurs [est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Plus fort que le grondement des grandes eaux, \q plus fort que le fracas des brisants de l’océan, \q {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est majestueux dans les hauteurs.
fr.R: Les flots grondent très fort, \q et les vagues de l’océan sont puissantes, \q mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, dans le ciel, est bien plus grand.

sw.L: Kuliko sauti za maji mengi, \q mkuu kuliko mawimbi ya bahari, \q mkuu juu [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Juu ya ngurumo ya maji makuu, \q juu ya mshindo wa mawimbi ya bahari, \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mkuu juu mbinguni.
sw.R: Mafuriko yanavuma kwa sauti kuu, \q na mawimbi ya bahari yana nguvu, \q lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliye mbinguni ni mkuu zaidi sana.

es.L: Más que el estruendo de las muchas aguas, \q más majestuoso que las rompientes del mar, \q majestuoso en lo alto [es] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Por encima del rugido de las grandes aguas, \q por encima del estrépito de las olas del océano, \q {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es majestuoso en lo alto.
es.R: Las aguas rugen con fuerza, \q y las olas del océano son poderosas, \q pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, en el cielo, es mucho más grande.

vi.L: Hơn tiếng của nhiều dòng nước, \q uy nghi hơn những đợt sóng của biển, \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là Đấng] uy nghi ở nơi cao.
vi.B: Trên tiếng gầm của muôn dòng nước lớn, \q trên tiếng sóng vỗ của đại dương, \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ngự trên cao đầy uy nghi.
vi.R: Nước lũ gầm thét vang dội, \q và sóng biển thật mạnh mẽ, \q nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở trên trời còn vĩ đại hơn nhiều.

ko.L: 많은 물의 소리보다, \q 바다의 위세 있는 물결보다 더 위엄 있으신 분, \q 높은 곳에 계신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 위엄이 있으십니다.
ko.B: 큰물이 울부짖는 소리보다 \q 바다의 부서지는 물결보다 더 크게, \q 높은 곳에 계신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 위엄을 떨치십니다.
ko.R: 큰물이 크게 울부짖고 \q 바다의 물결이 거세지만, \q 하늘에 계신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 그보다 훨씬 더 크십니다.

pt.L: Mais que as vozes de muitas águas, \q mais majestoso que as ondas do mar, \q majestoso nas alturas [é] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Acima do rugido das grandes águas, \q acima do estrondo das ondas do oceano, \q {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} é majestoso nas alturas.
pt.R: As águas rugem com força, \q e as ondas do mar são fortes, \q mas {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, no céu, é muito maior.

am.L: ከብዙ ውኆች ድምፅ ይልቅ፣ \q ከባሕርም ማዕበል ይልቅ ግሩም የሆነ፣ \q በከፍታ ያለው {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ግሩም [ነው]።
am.B: ከታላላቅ ውኆች ጩኸት በላይ፣ \q ከውቅያኖስ ማዕበሎች ግጭት በላይ፣ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በከፍታ ግሩም ነው።
am.R: ጎርፎች በታላቅ ድምፅ ይጮኻሉ፤ \q የውቅያኖስ ማዕበሎችም ብርቱዎች ናቸው፤ \q በሰማይ ያለው {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ግን እጅግ ይበልጣል።

hi.L: बहुत जल के शब्दों से अधिक, \q समुद्र की लहरों से अधिक प्रतापी, \q ऊँचे पर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} प्रतापी [हैं]।
hi.B: महान जलों के गर्जन से ऊपर, \q महासागर की टकराती लहरों से ऊपर, \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ऊँचे पर प्रतापी हैं।
hi.R: बाढ़ का पानी ज़ोर से गरजता है, \q और महासागर की लहरें प्रबल हैं, \q पर स्वर्ग में {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उनसे कहीं महान हैं।

ru.L: Сильнее шума многих вод, \q величественнее морских бурунов, \q величествен в вышине {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Выше рёва великих вод, \q выше грохота океанских волн, \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} величествен в вышине.
ru.R: Потоки громко ревут, \q и волны океана сильны, \q но {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} на небесах намного могущественнее.

ja.L: 多くの水のとどろきにまさり、 \q 海の砕け波よりも力強く、 \q 高い所で力強い方、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}。
ja.B: 大水のとどろきにまさって、 \q 大海の砕ける波にまさって、 \q 高い所におられる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は力強い。
ja.R: 洪水は大きな音をたて、 \q 海の波は力強い。 \q しかし、天におられる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、それよりはるかに偉大だ。

decisions.reason: The opening "than" (min) governs both lines: the LORD is greater than the waters and greater than the breakers. Some read "majestic" with the waters ("the majestic breakers"); the sense is the same.
The word ('addir) is used of the sea's power and then of the LORD's: whatever the sea has, he has more (8:2).
"Many waters" is a fixed phrase for overwhelming waters (18:17; 29:3).

decisions.choice: The LORD is spoken of in the third person with the honorific inside the prayer of verses 2-5, in 합쇼체
alternatives: the plain written style for this verse
decisions.reason: The verse names the LORD in the third person but stands between lines addressed to him, so Korean keeps the polite style of the surrounding prayer.

decisions.choice: 'addir "力強い" (L, B), "偉大" (R); mayim rabbim "多くの水" (L), "大水" (B), "洪水" (R)
decisions.reason: A comparison (m1, uncertain): the LORD is mightier than the waters; 'addir is mighty and glorious (m2); many waters are the great flood (m3).

source.text: עֵֽדֹתֶ֨יךָ׀נֶאֶמְנ֬וּ מְאֹ֗ד לְבֵיתְךָ֥ נַאֲוָה־קֹ֑דֶשׁ יְ֝הוָ֗ה לְאֹ֣רֶךְ יָמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Your testimonies are reliable exceedingly; to your house holiness is fitting, YHWH, for length of days.

en.L: Your testimonies are very reliable; \q holiness befits {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} house, \q {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, for length of days.
en.B: Your decrees can be fully trusted; \q holiness suits {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} house, \q {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, for all time to come.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, everything {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have said can be fully trusted. \q Your house will be holy forever.

fr.L: Tes témoignages sont très sûrs ; \q la sainteté convient à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} maison, \q {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, pour la longueur des jours.
fr.B: On peut se fier entièrement à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} décrets ; \q la sainteté sied à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} maison, \q {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, pour tous les temps à venir.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, on peut avoir entièrement confiance en tout ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as dit. \q Ta maison sera sainte pour toujours.

sw.L: Shuhuda {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} ni za kuaminika sana; \q utakatifu unaifaa nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, \q Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa wingi wa siku.
sw.B: Maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yanaaminika kabisa; \q utakatifu unaifaa nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, \q Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa nyakati zote zijazo.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kila ulichosema kinaaminika kabisa. \q Nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} itakuwa takatifu milele.

es.L: Tus testimonios son muy fieles; \q la santidad conviene a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} casa, \q {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, por largos días.
es.B: Tus decretos son del todo dignos de confianza; \q la santidad le sienta bien a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} casa, \q {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, por todos los tiempos venideros.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, todo lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has dicho es digno de toda confianza. \q Tu casa será santa para siempre.

vi.L: Các lời chứng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rất đáng tin cậy; \q sự thánh khiết xứng hợp với nhà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, cho đến những ngày dài lâu.
vi.B: Các điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hoàn toàn đáng tin cậy; \q sự thánh khiết thật xứng với nhà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, cho đến muôn đời.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán đều hoàn toàn đáng tin cậy. \q Nhà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ thánh khiết mãi mãi.

ko.L: 주님의 증거들은 매우 확실하고, \q 거룩함이 주님의 집에 어울립니다, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 오래도록.
ko.B: 주님께서 주신 법도는 온전히 믿을 만합니다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 거룩함이 주님의 집에 \q 길이길이 어울립니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서 하신 말씀은 모두 믿을 수 있습니다. \q 주님의 집은 영원히 거룩할 것입니다.

pt.L: Os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} testemunhos são muito confiáveis; \q a santidade convém à {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} casa, \q {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, por longos dias.
pt.B: Os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} decretos merecem toda a confiança; \q a santidade fica bem à {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} casa, \q {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, por todo o tempo que há de vir.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, tudo o que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} disseste merece toda a confiança. \q A {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} casa será santa para sempre.

am.L: ምስክርነቶችህ እጅግ የታመኑ ናቸው፤ \q ቅድስና ለቤትህ ይገባል፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ለረጅም ዘመን።
am.B: የሰጠኸው ምስክርነት ፈጽሞ የሚታመን ነው፤ \q ቅድስና ለቤትህ ይስማማል፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ለሚመጣው ዘመን ሁሉ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ የተናገርከው ሁሉ ፈጽሞ የሚታመን ነው። \q ቤትህ ለዘላለም ቅዱስ ይሆናል።

hi.L: तेरी चितौनियाँ अति विश्वसनीय हैं; \q तेरे भवन को पवित्रता शोभा देती है, \q हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, दिनों की लंबाई तक।
hi.B: तेरी चितौनियों पर पूरा भरोसा किया जा सकता है; \q पवित्रता तेरे भवन को शोभा देती है, \q हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, आनेवाले सब युगों तक।
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, जो कुछ तूने कहा है, उस पर पूरा भरोसा किया जा सकता है। \q तेरा भवन सदा पवित्र रहेगा।

ru.L: Твои свидетельства весьма надёжны; \q {{deity_pronoun:твоему|Твоему}} дому подобает святость, \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, на долготу дней.
ru.B: Твоим постановлениям можно полностью доверять; \q святость подобает {{deity_pronoun:твоему|Твоему}} дому, \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, на все грядущие времена.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, всему, что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} сказал, можно полностью доверять. \q Твой дом будет святым вечно.

ja.L: あなたの証しは、まことに確かである。 \q 聖なることが、あなたの家にふさわしい、 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、日々の続く限り。
ja.B: あなたのさとしは、まったく信頼できる。 \q 聖なることが、あなたの家にふさわしい、 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、いつまでも。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたが示されたことはみな、すっかり信頼できる。 \q あなたの家は、いつまでも聖なる所である。

decisions.reason: The word ('edot) is used of the terms of the covenant (19:8; 119:2). Beside the firm world and throne (verses 1-2), God's word also stands firm.
The King's house is his temple, which must be kept holy (5:8; 24:3-4).

decisions.choice: is fitting: is right for, adorns
decisions.reason: The verb (na'ah) means to be fitting or beautiful (33:1).
Readable says what the testimonies are (m1).
As the terms list sets the word for Psalm 119, so the law words read alike through the Psalms.

The testimonies are God's solemn covenant words (meaning m1). The plural ('edot) is "चितौनियाँ" at Literal and Balanced, as in Deuteronomy (4:45; 6:17, 20) and through Psalm 119 in this translation, even where the English Balanced says "decrees"; the singular ('edut) stays "साक्षी", as in the Pentateuch's "साक्षी-पत्र". Readable says what the testimonies are, "जो कुछ तूने कहा है", as its English does.
'Edot are God's solemn words (m1); Literal keeps "свидетельства", the word the Pentateuch uses, and Balanced says "постановления", as Psalm 25:10 does.

decisions.choice: 'edotekha "あなたの証し" (L), "あなたのさとし" (B), "あなたが示されたこと" (R, the Psalm 119 table); leveitkha "あなたの家"
decisions.reason: The Psalter's forms for 'edot (PSA-3): God's solemn words (m1); the house is the temple (m2).
